question: The dimension of the Hockey field is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 91.4 m long and 55 m wide.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The International Hockey Federation (FIH) has specified the standard dimensions for a hockey field, which is 91.4 m long and 55 m wide.**
 
• This is the most widely used dimension for hockey fields in** international competitions **and matches.
 
• A** 2.14 m high by 3.66 m wide **goal is located at each end, and there are lines in the middle of the field and across it that are **22.90 m **from each end line.
 
• **The penalty spot, also known as the stroke mark, is a spot with a diameter of 0.15 meters that is positioned 6.40 meters from the center of each goal.**
 
• It is **15 meters** from the base line to the **shooting circle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Field hockey** is a team sport that follows the regular hockey format.
 
• **Teams consist of a goalie and ten field players for a total of 11 players per team. **
 
• Teams have to move a hockey ball across a pitch by striking it into the goal and then the shooting circle of the opposition team with a hockey stick.
 
• **The team with the highest goal total wins the game.**
 
• **Games are played on artificial turf, grass, boards indoor surfaces, or irrigated turf.**
